arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler argued federal law requires FDA approval for new drugs.
Mr. Hoffman presented the opposing sides' position on state waivers.
Chief Justice Rehnquist asked if pharmacists must call pharmacies for consultations.
The Court submitted the case after hearing both advocates.
